# Jonathan Worotikan

> Jonathan Worotikan (full name Jonathan Wisnu P. Worotikan) is a Software Engineer and IT Manager based in Bogor, West Java, Indonesia. He has been writing code professionally since 2010 (15+ years) and builds enterprise software, Odoo ERP modules, cloud infrastructure and 3D Virtual Tour platforms for Indonesian government institutions. He is open to freelance projects, IT consulting and engineering leadership roles.

Website: https://jworotikan.github.io/
Last updated: 2026-11-10

## Key facts

- Current role: IT Manager & Operations Manager at PT. Teknologi GoVirtual Indonesia (Oct 2025 – present), reporting to the CEO.
- Location: Bogor, West Java, Indonesia. Works with clients in Jakarta and across Indonesia.
- Experience: 15+ years, since 2010.
- Live platforms: 6 government and national platforms, including Portal Eksplorasi Indonesia with Bappenas.
- Certifications: 7 Dicoding certificates (AWS Cloud Practitioner, Dasar DevOps, Back-End Development, JavaScript Fundamentals, Front-End Web, Web Programming, Java for Beginners).
- Education: Bachelor of Information Systems, Universitas Terbuka (2024 – present).
- Languages: Indonesian (native), English (professional working proficiency).

## Services

- 3D Virtual Tour platforms: end-to-end development for government clients, including production-to-live server migration.
- Custom software & Odoo: web applications and Odoo modules for permits, HRIS, project management, surveys and reporting.
- Backend & DevOps: Laravel, Python and Node.js back-ends on MySQL, PostgreSQL, Linux, Docker and AWS.
- Web & mobile applications: responsive web apps and cross-platform React Native apps.

## Tech stack

- Languages: PHP, Python, JavaScript, Node.js, VB.Net
- Frameworks: Laravel, Odoo, Express.js, React Native
- Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, XML, Pano2VR
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Firebase
- Cloud & server: AWS, Linux / CentOS, Docker, cPanel, Git
- AI workflow: Claude Code, AI-assisted code review, rapid prototyping

## Experience

- Oct 2025 – present: IT Manager & Operations Manager, PT. Teknologi GoVirtual Indonesia (Jakarta)
- Apr 2024 – Jul 2025: IT Officer & Programmer, Living World Grand Wisata (Bekasi)
- Jun 2017 – Jan 2024: IT Manager & Software Engineer, PT. I-Management Indonesia (Jakarta). Clients: Bank Mayora, Wilmar Group, Mayapada Bank, Bank Papua; built rekap.kemdikbud.go.id for the Ministry of Education.
- Jun 2018 – Mar 2024: IT Programmer, PT. Inter Pan Pasifik Futures (Jakarta). Delivered volksfx.com and fxinterpan.com.
- Jun 2016 – Dec 2016: PIC Sales & Marketing, Bogor Region, X-TRO (XL Axiata)
- Jul 2010 – Jun 2016: Network & Software Engineer, CV. Withtech (Bogor)
